tweetText: Meta launched Business Agent to automate shopping and support in its messaging apps like Instagram and Messenger. This move puts AI at the heart of social commerce, changing how brands interact with customers. via AI News.
Microsoft is testing a new Autopilot feature that can work independently across M365. This could transform how users interact with technology, making tasks easier and more efficient. via AI News

Amazon is launching an AI shopping assistant for retailers, starting with Kate Spade. This move allows brands to personalize shopping experiences, enhancing customer engagement and boosting sales. via AI News.

Endava is transforming software delivery by integrating AI agents like ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to boost automation and efficiency. This shift is crucial for fostering an AI-native culture in the tech industry. via OpenAI News

ChatGPT just launched a new memory feature that helps it remember your preferences and keep conversations more relevant. This means a more personalized and helpful experience for users! via OpenAI News

Anthropic's Daniela Amodei reports the company's revenue skyrocketed to $47 billion as it approaches its IPO. This growth highlights the rapid evolution of AI, but raises questions about its sustainability moving forward. via TechCrunch AI

Airbnb's CEO Brian Chesky announced plans to launch a new AI lab after deciding existing LLM products weren't ready for partnership. This move could enhance Airbnb's tech offerings and improve user experience. via TechCrunch AI

Investors and tech leaders will meet on June 18 at The Aerospace Corporation Campus to discuss key trends in venture capital, defense tech, and AI. This event highlights the growing importance of these sectors in shaping the future. via TechCrunch AI
Apple has approved Poke as the first AI agent on its Messages for Business platform. This marks a significant step in integrating AI into everyday communication for businesses. via TechCrunch AI

Meta has launched a new AI creator assistant on Facebook that helps users get quick answers about their performance and engagement. This tool simplifies data analysis for creators, making it easier to optimize their content. via TechCrunch AI
